## Description

A thecate freshwater dinoflagellate, almost spherical and somewhat flattened (45–60 µm), with
cellulose plates, brown chloroplasts, an equatorial groove (cingulum) with the transverse flagellum and
the longitudinal one trailing. The cingulum flagellum makes it spin about its axis while the
longitudinal one pushes it: it advances in a helix.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

[Helical swimming](../../mechanics/locomotion.md) (`helix_radius`, `helix_period`): seen from above, a lateral
oscillation. Rigid cellulose theca like *Ceratium*. Phototaxis and cysts.
